# telnyx_ai_memory_namespace_operation (Data Source)

The status of a write to an AI memory namespace.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `namespace` (String) The namespace.
- `operation_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `completed_at` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `status` (String) Where the write is. `completed`, `failed` and `cancelled` are terminal: stop polling at any of them, and treat `failed` and `cancelled` as writes that did not happen.
